query: 0.33 NA 的 Rayleigh 景深是 ±62 nm，有研究测得不同 pitch 之间 wafer 端 telecentricity 差异最大约 11 mrad，那在景深极限处不同 pitch 的图形错位能有多少纳米？占 IRDS 2025 年 2.0 nm 套刻指标多大比例？
gold_standard: 图形放置误差 = telecentricity 差异 × 离焦量 = 11×10⁻³ × 62 nm = 0.68 nm（书中式 6.2）。对比 2020 年 IRDS 对 2025 年逻辑器件 2.0 nm 的套刻要求，0.68 nm 约占整个套刻预算的 1/3（34%），说明从套刻角度出发焦点必须比仅按线宽考虑控制得更紧。
success_criteria: 给出 11e-3 × 62 nm = 0.68 nm 的算式，并得出约占 2.0 nm 预算 1/3（~34%）的结论
evidence: --[p161]-- In one study, differences in telecentricity among pitches for 0.33-NA optics was found to be as large as 11 mrad (see Fig. 6.14). For 0.33-NA optics, the Rayleigh depth of focus is ±62 nm. At the limits of this focus range, the induced relative pattern placement errors would be --[p163]-- 11×10⁻³ × 62 nm = 0.68 nm, which is a large fraction of overlay budgets for the 7-nm node and beyond. For EUV lithography, this means that focus needs to be controlled much more tightly on the basis of overlay considerations than by regarding linewidths alone. --[p160]-- Note that the overlay requirement in the 2020 IRDS for logic in the year 2025 is 2.0 nm, so the largest placement shifts due to defocus represent a significant fraction of the total overlay budget.

query: 拼接（stitching）曝光的时候，黑边（black border）为什么会给套刻带来麻烦？黑边本身在掩模上是怎么做出来的？
gold_standard: 先检索黑边的形成：为在曝光区边缘获得真正不反光的暗边，EUV 掩模把曝光区外的多层反射膜刻蚀掉（消除主反射体），该区域即黑边；再检索其后果：多层膜有应力，刻蚀多层膜会在黑边附近造成掩模机械形变，做拼接（较大芯片跨两个亚视场）时必须把这种形变纳入考虑，否则拼接边界处图形会错位，因此光学光刻里常规的重叠曝光在 EUV 中更复杂。
success_criteria: 答出黑边=刻蚀多层膜以消除边缘反射，且答出多层膜应力导致掩模形变需在 stitching 中补偿
evidence: --[p84]-- A common solution for providing a truly dark edge to the exposure area for EUV lithography is to etch the multilayer, as illustrated in Fig. --[p85]-- 4.5, thereby eliminating the primary reflector just outside of the exposure area. This etched area is often referred to as the “black border.” --[p229]-- Overlapping exposures are done routinely in optical lithography, but it is somewhat more complex for EUV lithography. As discussed in Chapter 4, a “black border” is frequently added to EUV masks to address the residual reflectance from absorbers on the masks. The etching of the multilayer to create a black border will cause mechanical distortion of the mask near the border due to stress in the multilayers, and this needs to be taken into account when stitching.

query: 0.55 NA 高数值孔径机台为什么非要把镜头缩减倍率从 4× 提到 8× 不可？ASML/Zeiss 用变形（anamorphic）镜头后晶圆上的视场变成多大？比这更大的芯片怎么办？
gold_standard: 链式推理：(1) 掩模 3D 效应显著，若 0.55 NA 仍用 4× 缩减，掩模上最大入射角会大得多（表 10.1：0.55 NA 4× 时 17.3°，8× 时降到 9.5°），缓解办法是提高缩减倍率到 8×（ASML 与 Zeiss 的路线）；(2) 但 8× 各向同性缩减会把晶圆视场缩小 4 倍，为避免视场缩小 2 倍，采用 x 方向 4×、y 方向 8× 的变形镜头设计，4× 各向同性系统的 26 mm × 33 mm 视场变为晶圆上 26 mm × 16.5 mm（仅缩小 2 倍）；(3) 大于 26 mm × 16.5 mm 的芯片必须做 stitching（拼接），拼接后每层需要两张（或更多）掩模和曝光。
success_criteria: 依次答出：掩模 3D 效应/入射角原因→8× 缩减→anamorphic x:4×/y:8×→视场 26 mm×16.5 mm→更大芯片需 stitching 且每层≥2 张掩模
evidence: --[p227]-- One way to mitigate mask 3D effects is to increase the lens reduction, and increasing lens reduction to 8 is the approach being taken by ASML and Zeiss. --[p227 [表]]-- Table 10.1 Chief-ray angles and maximum angles of incidence on the mask for various combinations of NA (wafer level) and lens reduction. 0.33 | 4× | 6° | 10.8° 0.55 | 4× | 9° | 17.3° 0.55 | 8× | 5.3° | 9.5° --[p228]-- However, with 8 lens reduction, field size on the wafer must necessarily be reduced without an increase of reticle size, and such an increase is currently not planned. To avoid decreasing the wafer field area by 4, an anamorphic lens design has been proposed, with lens reduction different in the x and y directions: 8 in the y direction and 4 in the x direction. --[p228]-- The 26 mm 33 mm field size of 4× isomorphic systems becomes 26 mm 16.5 mm on the wafer. This enables the benefit of higher lens reduction to reduce the mask 3D effects substantially, while reducing field size by only 2. --[p228]-- Stitching of exposure fields will be required for chips larger than 26 mm 16.5 mm. With stitching, every layer requires two (or more) masks and exposures.
